title: First Roll Over
desc: You figured out gravity is optional. Or at least that you can negotiate with it. Tummy to back, first try.
story: We were doing tummy time on the play mat — your least favourite activity — when you suddenly gathered an enormous amount of determination, grunted very seriously for about ten seconds, and flipped yourself right over. Then looked at us like 'was that good?' Yes, baby. That was absolutely extraordinary.
